findings.evidence: Glob: `Diffractive/Kinematics.lean` and `Diffractive/Kinematics/Basic.lean` both exist; `Kinematics.lean:8-9` imports only `DIS.Kinematics.Basic` and `Exclusive.Kinematics.Basic`, not `Kinematics/Basic.lean`. Grep for `DIS\.Diffractive` imports shows `Kinematics/MomentumTransferBound.lean:8` and `OffForwardBoundary.lean:9` importing `...Diffractive.Kinematics`. Repo-wide glob of `**/{Kinematics,Basic}.lean` shows no other `X.lean`+`X/` pair.
findings.fix: In this PR, `git mv` the contents of `Diffractive/Kinematics.lean` into the directory — e.g. `Kinematics/Invariants.lean` for the `Invariants` section and `Kinematics/Boundary.lean` for `tMin`/`tMinElastic` and the new `tMin_*` lemmas — delete the old module path, and point the three importers (`Kinematics/MomentumTransferBound.lean`, `OffForwardBoundary.lean`, plus `Kinematics/LightCone.lean` if needed) at the new paths. No declaration renames required; `MomentumTransferBound.lean` then imports only the boundary module.
findings.issue: `tMin` and friends were added to `Diffractive/Kinematics.lean`, so the new files inside `Diffractive/Kinematics/` depend upward on the module that names their directory (`public import ...Diffractive.Kinematics` at line 8, and the same at `OffForwardBoundary.lean:9`). `Diffractive/Kinematics.lean` is the repo's only content-bearing `X.lean` sitting beside an `X/` directory — everywhere else the entry file is `X/Basic.lean` (`DIS/Kinematics/Basic.lean`, `DIS/Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean`, `Photoproduction/Kinematics/Basic.lean`) — and `Diffractive/Kinematics/Basic.lean` already exists and is not imported by it. A concrete consequence: `MomentumTransferBound.lean` needs only `tMin`, but importing `Diffractive.Kinematics` drags in the `Invariants` structure and the whole `Exclusive.Kinematics.Basic` bridge.

summary: The new light-cone and bound files are in the right subdirectory and the general `bilinForm_self_eq_two_mul_plus_mul_minus_add` is in its canonical home; no unused or over-broad imports. One structural issue: the new boundary material sits in `Diffractive/Kinematics.lean`, so files inside `Diffractive/Kinematics/` now import their own parent module.
